name: Cloudflare Basra edge data center
notes: Cloudflare's official network page lists Basra, IQ among Middle East data center locations; capacity not disclosed.

name: Cloudflare Baghdad data center
notes: Cloudflare announced its Baghdad, Iraq data center in March 2018 and current official network page still lists Baghdad, IQ.

name: Iraq National Data Center / National Cloud Facility
developer: Government of Iraq / General Secretariat of the Cabinet
notes: Prime Minister Mohammed Shia' Al-Sudani inaugurated the National Data Center at the General Secretariat of the Cabinet; first phase included National Cloud Facility installation work. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Nokia / Ministry of Communications state-owned commercial data centers - Al Intisar and Al Rasheed exchange
developer: Iraq Ministry of Communications / General Communications and Information Company / Nokia
notes: Contract announced for two modern state-owned data centers in Baghdad, one at Al Intisar and another at Al Rasheed exchange in Al Senak district; intended for government and private-sector customers. Capacity not disclosed.

name: T964 Tier III colocation data center
notes: Carrier-neutral commercial Tier III facility under construction for launch by end-2026; phase 1 has 340 racks and capacity scaling up to 12 MW, with DCD noting T964 site separately states 3 MW IT load and 84 MW site power access.

name: Cloudflare Nasiriyah edge data center
notes: Cloudflare's official network page lists Nasiriyah, IQ among Middle East data center locations; Nasiriyah is in Dhi Qar Governorate. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Kurdistan Regional Government Tier III data center
developer: Kurdistan Regional Government Department of Information Technology
notes: KRG opened a Tier III-based government data center in early September 2022; KRG states capacity is around 320 kW and intended to host/digitalize over 300 government services.

name: Cloudflare Erbil edge data center
notes: Cloudflare announced Erbil among 18 new global network cities in March 2022 and current official network page lists Erbil, IQ. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Cloudflare Sulaymaniyah edge data center
notes: Cloudflare's official network page lists Sulaymaniyah, IQ among Middle East data center locations; capacity not disclosed.

name: Asiacell Erbil Data Center - 2
notes: Uptime Institute awards listing identifies Asiacell as client and project 'Erbil Data Center - 2' located in Erbil, Iraq. Capacity and award dates not visible in crawled text.

name: Maysan Oil Company modular data center
developer: Maysan Oil Company / Smart Oasis / CNOOC / Huawei
notes: RAS/Smart Oasis reported successful Factory Acceptance Test at Huawei factories for the Maysan Oil Company modular data center project in collaboration with CNOOC; capacity not disclosed.
